title: The Final Alibi
author: Gideon Ishikawa
blurb: Gideon Ishikawa, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
